Days when the House will not meet are allocated for committee meetings, etc. Committee meetings can also be held on days when the House is meeting, before or after the House meeting.
Other matters as per Chapters 24, 27, and 30 of the Regulations may be included in the agenda as needed.
Time for the Honorable Minister to seek time for a statement of public importance will be provided at the beginning of the meeting, and time for responding to Zero Hour/Special Time/Emergency Time will be provided after Zero Hour.
Time will be made available to the Leader of the Opposition, former Prime Ministers, former Speakers, etc., in accordance with parliamentary practice.

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: The agenda for the House of Representatives meeting includes Zero Hour, Special Time, and the presentation of messages and bills. Key legislative items include the Water Resources Bill, Nepal Veterinary Council Bill, and National Citizenship Amendment Bill.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: This section details the legislative agenda for various dates, including discussions on the Children's Bill, Constitutional Council Bill, and the Work, Rights and Procedures Bill. It also includes provisions for question and answer sessions and ministry-wise discussions.

sections.name: Special Time and Committee Reports
sections.summary_en: The agenda includes Special Time and the presentation of the Education, Science and Technology Committee's report on the Education Bill, 2080, with a proposal for discussion and passage. It also mentions the possibility of urgent matters being added to the agenda.
reports_presented: Report of the Education, Science and Technology Committee

sections.name: Further Business
sections.summary_en: This section outlines further agenda items including discussions on the Water Resources Bill, ministry-wise discussions, and question and answer sessions. It also addresses the allocation of time for ministerial statements and responses.

sections.name: Additional Provisions
sections.summary_en: The agenda includes Zero Hour, Special Time, and the Nepal Veterinary Council Bill, with a proposal to send it for clause-by-clause discussion. It also notes that committee meetings can be held on days when the House is not in session and that other regulatory matters may be included.
